title: Low-Wick Fisher coercivity on the ultraviolet shell

shell_coercivity.shell_constants: Let P_N be K1530's fixed-ratio shell, Tr(P_N Lambda)>=kappa C_N, and P_N Lambda^2 Omega^(-1)P_N<=a_N P_N Lambda with a_N<=L N^(-2)
shell_coercivity.low_wick_to_variance: For 0<=beta<c_*, nu in M_beta and 0<eta<kappa, E_nu W_N<=(c_*-beta)eta C_N^2 implies V_N=Tr(Lambda S)<=eta C_N
shell_coercivity.frobenius_bound: K1530's order-preserving factorization gives delta_N^2<=Tr[Omega(S+S^(-1)-2I)] Tr[P_N Lambda^2 Omega^(-1)P_N S]
shell_coercivity.dual_bound: The second factor is at most a_N Tr(P_N Lambda S)<=a_N eta C_N
shell_coercivity.fisher_consequence: K1533 therefore gives I_Omega(nu|mu)>=(kappa-eta)^2 C_N/(a_N eta), including arbitrary non-Gaussian densities and phases in M_beta
shell_coercivity.scope_guard: The theorem requires the integrated moment-defect budget defining M_beta; the smooth two-well counterexample proves that covariance and Fisher extremality alone do not supply it
